versions.content: Serialization of ServiceInterface s using ComBased- Transformer If the ComBasedTransformer is used to serialize the members of a ServiceInterface , then • the SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping is used to map the Vari- ableDataPrototype that represents an Event or Field Notifier to a SystemSignalGroup . Please note that the datatype of an Event is a Struc- ture as described above. Each primitive member of this Structure is mapped by the SenderRecRecordElementMapping to a SystemSignal in the System- SignalGroup . The SystemSignalGroup is mapped as ISignalGroup into an ISignalIPdu that is transported over the network. • the serialization of Method s, Field Setter s, Field Getter s by the Com- BasedTransformer is not supported.
